Make ONE high-resolution isolated horizontal kill-frame asset, source No.087, exact variant broken_covenant_strong, theme broken_covenant, intensity strong, role unspecified. Image 1 is the exact cropped variant to reconstruct. Image 2 is the complete original sheet for context: reconstruct ONLY the variant shown in Image 1, never another row. Create a crisp richly detailed 2K-or-higher painted metallic/fantasy/sci-fi UI asset on an actual transparent RGBA canvas, preferably 2560 pixels wide, no blurry upscaling. Preserve the reference silhouette, palette, material, exact portrait-ring shape (round or angular), both left/right borders, central ornament, connecting bars, spacing, line weights and theme motifs. Weak and strong variants must remain distinct. Remove champion faces, heads, hair, people, portrait occupants, ALL text/numbers/labels and scenery. Both portrait interiors must be entirely empty alpha-zero holes. Keep native decorative animal/mascot ornaments only if part of the frame. Do not add generic symbols, larger invented central emblems, extra frames or a whole contact sheet. No logo, watermark, paper or checkerboard painted into pixels. Keep the ENTIRE frame and every feather/flame/light/particle tip inside a generous fully transparent 15% margin on every side. Local translucent glow is allowed; the background and all negative spaces must be truly transparent. Single usable frame only, no title or presentation.  Additional source-fidelity constraints: empty reference spaces must remain empty. If portrait frames and the central ornament are separate in the exact crop, preserve those gaps; do not invent connecting bars, outer arcs, stars, gems, flowers or spikes. Never borrow ornament from adjacent strong variants. A central X or cross that belongs to the frame is a required structural ornament: retain its exact form; remove explanatory writing only, not the cross.  Keep native solid black eclipse discs, dark orbs and other dark ornament opaque where the exact source shows them; these are not empty portrait holes. Preserve blank paper talisman silhouettes while removing all writing. Do not replace missing writing with new objects or characters.
